$comment: Copy for the states a connectivity product spends most of its time in. Written as practical sentences rather than labels: 'Pending' tells someone nothing, 'Paid — your line is being set up' tells them the money left and the work has not finished. design-system.md §17 explains the rules these follow.

pendingProvisioning.title: Your line is being set up
pendingProvisioning.body: We have your payment. Setting up a line with the network usually takes a few minutes. You do not need to stay on this screen — we will let you know when it is ready to install.

outcomeUnknown.title: We are confirming with the network
outcomeUnknown.body: We did not get a clear answer about this line, so we are confirming it before doing anything else. You have not been charged twice and we will not order a second line.
outcomeUnknown.reassurance: Nothing further is needed from you.

usage.staleExplanation: Usage can take a little while to reach us, so this may be behind what you have actually used.
usage.neverUpdatedExplanation: We will show usage here once the network reports it.

partialFailure.title: {{failed}} of {{total}} lines could not be set up
partialFailure.bodyOne: {{succeeded}} line is ready. The rest can be retried without paying again.
partialFailure.bodyOther: {{succeeded}} lines are ready. The rest can be retried without paying again.
partialFailure.noCharge: Retrying does not charge you again.

empty.linesBody: Lines you buy will appear here, with their data and calls remaining.
empty.ordersBody: Your receipts and order history will appear here.
empty.peopleBody: Add people to assign lines to them and see their usage in one place.
empty.searchBody: Try a shorter search, or clear it to see everything.

unsupportedDevice.title: This phone cannot use an eSIM
unsupportedDevice.body: An eSIM plan needs a phone that supports one and is not locked to a single network. We checked this device and it does not.
unsupportedDevice.beforePaying: We check this before you pay so you are not left with a plan you cannot install.

error.title: That did not work
error.offlineBody: We will try again when you are back on a network. Anything you have already bought is safe.
error.genericBody: Something went wrong at our end. Nothing was charged.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every state pattern in the design system, on one screen. Change the language or the text size and everything here has to keep working.

calls.$comment: Calls copy. VOICE-EXPANSION.md gives DamDam two ways to make a call, and they bill, route and fail differently -- so which one is about to happen is stated, never inferred from context.
calls.modeCarrierBody: Placed with your phone's own dialler, over the DamDam line on your eSIM. Works with no internet.
calls.modeInternetBody: Placed inside DamDam over your internet connection. No eSIM needed.
calls.identityUnknown: We cannot confirm the number they will see
calls.identityUnknownDetail: The network decides which number is shown for this route. We will not guess.
calls.payerWorkNote: This call is on your work account. {{organization}} can see that it was made, its length and its cost — not what was said.
calls.payerPersonalNote: This call is on your own balance. Your organization cannot see it.
calls.rateEstimate: An estimate. The final cost depends on how long the call lasts and is charged in {{currency}}.
calls.rateUnknown: We do not have a rate for this destination
calls.rateUnknownDetail: We will not place a call we cannot price.
calls.keypadHelp: Use the keypad to enter menu options during a call.
calls.micDeniedBody: An internet call needs microphone access. You can turn it on in your phone's settings for DamDam.
calls.micDeniedAlternative: A carrier call does not need the microphone permission — it uses your phone's own dialler.
calls.lowCreditTitle: Not enough credit for this call
calls.lowCreditBody: You have {{balance}} left, and this call needs at least {{required}} to start.
calls.lowCreditWorkBody: This work account has {{balance}} left, and this call needs at least {{required}} to start. Ask an administrator at {{organization}} to add credit.
calls.unavailableTitle: Calls are not available here yet
calls.unavailableBody: We only offer calling where we can prove the route works. This destination is not one of them yet.
